content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the case involved two parties referred to as jsk and ok the defendant ok was ordered to pay €133341 for stamp duty and €245018 for legal fees the applicant jsk was required to pay €63107 for stamp duty the final resolution of the case involved the division of assets between the parties jsk was awarded an apartment kitchen furniture a washing machine a fridge and a tv set ok was entitled to a tv set as compensation additionally ok was ordered to pay jsk €241650 as compensation for the reduction of community property following the sale of a car the court referred to various articles from the civil code related to the division of assets in a matrimonial property regime the court will consider the evidence and arguments presented by both parties to make a decision on the case both parties are responsible for paying the state costs for stamp duty with jsk paying €63107 and ok paying €133341

civil_codes_used: Art. 3.87 The essence of the statutory matrimonial property regime
